suggested_visuals.section_heading: The cost baseline: anchoring the analysis to a real machine price
suggested_visuals.purpose: Give the reader a physical sense of what the $4,250 price buys and how much counter space it occupies, which the payback model treats as a real cost.
suggested_visuals.alt_text_proposal: A bartop arcade machine on a bar counter beside glassware and two stools, showing its compact footprint
suggested_visuals.production_note: Real photo of the ECHO Commercial Edition in a working bar setting; include everyday objects for scale rather than a clean studio shot.

suggested_visuals.section_heading: How probable is each scenario, and which one should an operator actually plan around
suggested_visuals.purpose: Show that placement is the single most correctable variable by contrasting a machine in the sightline from the bar with one in a back corner or corridor.
suggested_visuals.alt_text_proposal: Simple bar floor plan comparing a machine placed in view of the bar with one placed in a back corridor
suggested_visuals.production_note: Flat two-panel line diagram, no photography needed. Label the two positions clearly; keep it legible on mobile.

suggested_visuals.section_heading: Bringing the same machine home: where the ECHO Home edition fits for a private leisure space
suggested_visuals.purpose: Show the Home Edition in a believable adult home setting so the reader can judge scale and whether it suits their own room.
suggested_visuals.alt_text_proposal: ECHO bartop arcade on the counter of a finished basement home bar, lit by warm evening lighting
suggested_visuals.production_note: Real photo, quiet adult home setting (basement bar or den). No neon, no staged party scene, no children.
